meta.title: I'm Lily, and I'm Eight
meta.textType: functional: a profile page with questions and answers

paragraphs: Hello! Please read about me on my About me page. "What's your name?" I'm Lily, and I'm in Teacher Kim's class. "How old are you?" My age is eight, and my brother Tom is ten. "Where do you live?" My address is twelve Green Road, near the park. "Who lives with you?" I live with Mom, Dad, and Tom. We have a small brown puppy, too. His name is Pip.

"Who is in your family?" Mom and Dad are my parents. I'm their daughter, and Tom is their son. "Do you have a grandparent?" Yes, I do! Grandma and Grandpa are my grandparents, and they live near us. "Do you have an aunt or an uncle?" Yes, I do. Aunt Sue is Mom's sister, and Uncle Dan is Dad's brother. They're always kind to me.

"Who is your best friend?" My best friend is Mia, and she's eight, too. She lives in the house next to ours. "What do you like?" I like drawing, and Mia likes animals. We play in the park with Pip every day. "Is that all?" Yes, that's all about me! Now it's your day to write.
